questions.question: Supriya made a profit of 8% by selling a t-shirt after offering a discount of 10%. If the marked price of the t-shirt is Rs. 1,080, then find its cost price (in Rs.) for Supriya.
questions.solution:
Given :

A shopkeeper was selling a T-shirt at a discount of 10% so that he would earn a profit of 8%.

MP = 1080

Formula:

MP = SP × (100 - D)/100

SP = SP × (100 - P)/100

Calculation : 

Let the CP be x.

When the discount is 10%, profit is 8%,

Selling price = Cost price + Profit = x + 8% of x = 1.08x

∵ Marked price – Discount = Selling price

⇒ MP – 10% of MP = 1.08x

⇒ MP = 1.08x/0.9 = 1.2x

1.2x → 1080

x → 1080/1.2 = 900

**The answer is 900.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** 

(100 + P)/(100 - D) = MP/CP

⇒ 108/90 = 1080/CP

CP = 900

questions.question: If the difference between the compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum of money for 3 years at the rate of 4% per annum is Rs. 76, then what is the sum?
questions.solution:
Given:

The difference between compound and simple interest on a certain amount of money at 4% per annum after 3 years is Rs. 76

Formula Used:

When calculated at simple interest

Interest = (p × r × t)/100

Where p, r and t respectively are the principal, rate of interest and time

When calculated at compound interest

Amount (A) = p (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where p, r and n respectively are the principal, rate of interest and time

Compound interest = Amount – principal

Calculation:

Let the sum be Rs. 100%

Simple interest = (4% × 3) = 12%

Compounded interest 

⇒ 4% + 4% + 16/100% = 8.16%

⇒ 8.16% + 4% + (8.16 × 4)/100 = 12.4864%

According to the question

⇒ 12.4864% - 12% → 76

⇒ 0.4864% → 76

⇒ 1% → 76/0.4864 = 156.25

⇒ 100% → 15625

∴ The sum is 15625

questions.question: If the rate of simple interest in consecutive years is 4% and 5% respectively, then what will be the total amount payable on Rs. 25,000 in 2 years?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In **Simple Interest**, interest is always calculated on the **Principal**.

Total effective interest rate = 4% + 5% = 9%

Total Payable Amount = 100% (Principal) + 9% (Total SI) = 109% of 25,000

Amount = 25,000 × (109 ÷ 100) = 250 × 109 = 27,250

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 27,250.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = Rs. 25,000

**Rate** in 1st year (R₁) = 4%

**Rate** in 2ⁿd year (R₂) = 5%

**Time (T)** = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Total Amount (A) = Principal + Total SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c33e2a3a0e2c695b738ab8c4c16bbb9c28cba32372b3b1983bc7dc8e338bdf2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Interest for Year 1 = (25000 × 4 × 1) ÷ 100 = Rs. 1,000

⇒ Interest for Year 2 = (25000 × 5 × 1) ÷ 100 = Rs. 1,250

⇒ Total Simple Interest = 1,000 + 1,250 = Rs. 2,250

⇒ Total Amount = Principal + Total Interest

⇒ Total Amount = 25,000 + 2,250 = Rs. 27,250

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 27,250.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effective Simple Interest Rate

For consecutive years with different rates R₁, R₂, ..., Rₙ, the net rate is Rₑff = R₁ + R₂ + ... + Rₙ.

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

In SI, interest is only on the Principal, whereas in CI, interest is calculated on (Principal + accumulated Interest).

Amount Formula

Amount = P × [1 + (R₁ + R₂ + ... + Rₙ) ÷ 100], where P is the initial sum.</p

questions.question: Aditya can complete the work of painting a grill in 20 hours while Vinay can complete the same work in 15 hours. If Aditya and Vinay both work together, then in how many hours will the grill painting work be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Time taken by Aditya = 20 hours

Time taken by Vinay = 15 hours

**Formula**

Work = TIme × Efficiency

**Calculation**

Total work = LCM of 20 and 15 = 60

Efficiency of Aditya = 60/20 = 3

Efficiency of Vinay = 60/15 = 4

Time taken together = 60/(3 + 4) = 60/7 = 8(4/7) hours

**The answer is 8(4/7) hours.**

questions.question: The successive discounts of 15% and 20% is equivalent to a single discount of:
questions.solution:
Given:

The successive discount are 20% and 15%.

Formula used:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

Calculation:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

X = 20%, Y = 15%

⇒ 20 + 15 - 300/100

⇒ 32%

∴ The single equivalent discount is 32%.

questions.question: What is the largest five digit number exactly divisible by 88?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The largest 5-digit number that is exactly divisible by 88.

**Concept used:**

Reminder = dividend - quotient x divisor

Largest five-digit number = 99999

**Calculation :**

Divide the largest five-digit number by 88, and we got

remainder = 31

this means if the number was 31 less, it would be completely divisible by 88 After dividing 99999 with 88, we get 31 as the remainder.

so largest 5-digit number divisible by 88 = 99999-31 = 99968

**Hence, '99968' is the correct answer.**

questions.question: In triangle RST, M and N are two points on RS and RT such that MN is parallel to the base ST of the triangle RST. If RM = 1 over 3 MS, and ST = 5.6 cm, what is the ratio of the area of Δ RMN to the area of trapezium MNST?
questions.solution:
Given:

In ΔRST, points M and N are the points on sides RS and RT, respectively.

RM = 1 over 3 MS

ST = 5.6 cm

Concept Used:

For two similar triangles, the ratio of their areas will be in the ratio of the square of their corresponding sides.

Calculation:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef08dedbd55ba2ac1ba5dce17baf5d2ffb8b00b90dd534d7a4930e6a4220bc56.png] 

ΔRST, ∠RMN = ∠RST (Corresponding angles)

∠R is a common angle.

∴ ΔRST ∼ ΔRMN

⇒ RM/RS = MN/ST

⇒ 1/4 = MN/5.6

⇒ MN = 1.4

So, Area of ΔRST / Area ΔRMN = ST² / MN²

⇒ 5.6²/1.4²

⇒ 16

Suppose, the area of ΔRST is 16 sq. units, and the area of ΔRMN is 1 sq. units.

∴ Area of trapezium MNST = Area of ΔRST – Area of ΔRMN

⇒ 16 – 1

⇒ 15

Area of trapezium MNST : Area of ΔRMN = 15 : 1

**The answer is 1/15.**

questions.question: Two men do the same journey by travelling at the speed of 18 km/h and 24 km/h, respectively. If one man takes 20 minutes more than the other man, then the distance (in km) of the total journey is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Speed of one person, S₁ = 18 km/hour

Speed of second person, S₂ = 24 km/hour

T₁ – T₂ = 20 minutes

Formula used:

Speed = Distance/Time

Calculation:

Let the distance be x km.

Time taken by first person

⇒ Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ x/18 hour

Time taken by second person

⇒ x/24 hour

T₁ – T₂ = 20 minutes

⇒ x/18 – x/24 = 20/60

⇒ (4x – 3x)/72 = 1/3

⇒ x = 72/3

⇒ x = 24 km

∴ The distance travelled is 24 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0f6448757d2cde942412904dddc23f657eed29e61918cc552d57e9cc685ea3b.png] 

Required distance = {(S₁ × S₂)/(S₂ – S₁)} × (T₁ – T₂)

⇒ {(18 × 24)/(24 – 18)} × (20/60)

⇒ (18 × 24)/6) × (1/3)

⇒ 24 km

∴ The distance travelled is 24 km

questions.question: Akash bought an old phone for Rs. 3,450 and spent Rs. 450 on its repair. He sold it for Rs. 5,070. His profit percent is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

CP = 3450

Repair Price = 450

SP = 5070

**Formula used**

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

**Calculation**

The total cost of old phone = 3450 + 450 = 3900

Profit = 5070 - 3900 = 1170

Profit% = 1170/3900 × 100 = 30%

**The answer is 30%.**

questions.question: If two tangents inclined at an angle 120° are drawn to a circle of radius 6 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of each tangent?
questions.solution:
**Given**

If two tangents are inclined at an angle of 120°.

Radius = 6 cm.

**Concept used**

Tangents drawn from an external point are equal in length

**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00bbab724a3c57e8a459c3a3d4d8f9f0a272885fb34acd7d7e2074e8be22d2c9.png] 

Let P be the external points and PA and PB be the two tangents drawn to the circle with centre O.

Given : ∠APB = 120°

Also radius = OA = OB = 6 cm

We know that tangents drawn from an external point are equally inclined to the line joining that point to the centre.

∠APO = ∠BPO = ∠APB/2 = 120/2 = 60°

Now In ∆OAP

∠OAP = 90° (∵ Tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact)

Now in the right ∆OAP

∠OPA = 60°

tan 60° = OA/AP

⇒ √3 = 6/AP

⇒ AP = 6/√3 = 2√3

Also, tangents drawn from an external point are equal in length

⇒ AP = PB = 2√3

**The answer is 2√3.**

questions.question: If the length and breadth of a cuboid are increased by 7% and 6%, respectively, then the percentage increase in its volume is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The length of a cuboid is increased = 7%

The breadth of a cuboid is increased = 6%

Formula:

Volume of cuboid = l × b × h

Calculation: 

Let the length, breadth and height of the cuboid be 10 unit

Volume of cuboid = 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000 

New length of cuboid = 10 × (107/100) = 10.7

New breadth of cuboid = 10 × (106/100) = 10.6 

New height of cuboid = 10 

Volume of cuboid = 10.7 × 10.6 × 10 = 1134.2

Volume increase = 1134.2 - 1000 = 134.2

Volume percentage increase = (134.2/1000) × 100 = 13.42%

**The answer is 13.42%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** The successive increase = 7% + 6% + (7 × 6)%/100

⇒ 13.42%
